# Synthesis That Preserves

<p class="lens-meta"><code class="lens-code">SYNTHESIS</code> · Modern — analytic and scientific method · <strong>Catalogued — a reading, owns no gate</strong></p>

## The failure it names

a synthesis that quietly discards what it claimed to reconcile

## What it does

a synthesis node must `sublates` both parents and state what it keeps from each

## Worked example

Aufheben carries all three senses at once — to cancel, to preserve, to lift up. A synthesis citing only one parent has merely picked a side.

## Sources

- Hegel, Wissenschaft der Logik, Bk I §§185–188
- <https://plato.stanford.edu/entries/hegel-dialectics/>
